game.title: Assassin's Creed Mirage
game.blurb: Stealth action-adventure set in 9th-century Baghdad, from Ubisoft Bordeaux, released 2023-10-05. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Basim's rise from street thief to Hidden One. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Stealth, Tools and Notoriety
chapters.summary: Throwing knives, blowdarts, traps, smoke, pickpocketing, crowd assassinations and escaping notoriety.

chapters.title: Gear, Skills and Rank
chapters.summary: Hidden One rank, skills, weapon, outfit and tool upgrades, disguises and elixirs.

chapters.title: Exploring Baghdad
chapters.summary: Viewpoints, territories, lost books, enigmas, chests, folktales and Oud melodies.

chapters.title: Contracts and City Life
chapters.summary: Faction contracts, Tales from Baghdad, the Munadi and paying the city's factions.

chapters.title: Valley of Memory (AlUla)
chapters.summary: The AlUla expansion: its territories and prison escape.

chapters.title: Animus Sequence Replays
chapters.summary: Replaying sequences, their challenges and rewards.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3035570)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Assassin's_Creed_Mirage
Fandom (assassinscreed.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://assassinscreed.fandom.com/wiki/Assassin's_Creed:_Mirage
notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough and Gameplay are linked but no subpages exist. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under "Assassin's Creed: Mirage" (redirected from the plain title), with about 452 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "RIFT" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 3035570. RAWG lists Ubisoft, Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Bordeaux as developers. 12 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter, though a few (Curio Collector, Silencer, Unstoppable) may be side goals. The AlUla and Animus Sequence achievements look like later additions and get their own chapters.
